Member list is an actor map for the cell; news items announce new members (e.g. fintech startup 'Financial Solutions'), office openings and management changes.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegro-specific 'people moves' / appointments column or newsletter for fintech-crypto was found in either Serbian/Montenegrin or English.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for appointment terminology returned general ecosystem and regulator content, no dedicated moves tracker.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection for this cell must be assembled from company pages, LinkedIn and general news rather than from any single feed.

negative_findings.description: Direct queries for a fintech opening a Podgorica office and hiring a country manager returned no such concrete announcement.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only an adjacent example (Infinum's Podgorica office with a named managing director) and generic ecosystem pages surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that office-opening/country-manager signals in ME are sparse and must be caught via job boards and company office pages, not press.

negative_findings.description: Highest-value people-move sources (LinkedIn, Wellfound, Tracxn, Dealroom) are login-walled or paywalled.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only summary/snippet data reachable without accounts or licences.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget or manual-analyst capacity is required; automated collection alone will under-detect this cell.

negative_findings.description: Montenegrin startup media is thin and partly dormant — several of the most relevant Digitalizuj.Me items surfaced are from 2019-2022.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recent (2025-2026) local startup hiring coverage was not surfaced in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Freshness of local-language media coverage must be verified before relying on it as a primary detector.

negative_findings.description: Noisy terms identified: 'Coinis' (adtech, not crypto despite the name), 'Flash' (generic), 'Spark' (a Serbian youth conference at sparkconf.rs distinct from Montenegro's spark.me), 'startap/startup Crna Gora' (dominated by policy and grant content).
negative_findings.result_summary: Several searches returned off-target results driven by these terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection filters need disambiguation rules or precision will be poor.

coverage_gaps.description: Coastal hubs (Tivat/Porto Montenegro, Budva, Herceg Novi) where relocated crypto and nomad-founded fintech teams cluster have almost no indexed local-language source coverage; only a single Budva crypto-exchange site was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search Tivat/Budva municipal business news, Porto Montenegro tenant/press pages, coastal coworking spaces and expat/nomad communities; add local-language queries with 'Tivat', 'Budva', 'Porto Montenegro', 'kripto mjenjačnica'.

coverage_gaps.description: Founder-community channels (Telegram, Discord, Facebook groups such as 'Startup Montenegro', nomad/expat groups) were not explored; they carry hiring and relocation announcements first.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess Facebook group facebook.com/groups/1473577526209786 and comparable Telegram/Discord communities for access and legal viability.

coverage_gaps.description: The Montenegrin central company register (CRPS) was not examined in this pass; it would corroborate director changes and new company/branch registrations by fintech entrants.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout CRPS (Poreska uprava / privredni registar) for executive-director change records and branch registrations, as a corroborating layer to soft hiring signals.

coverage_gaps.description: Local and regional executive-search/staffing agencies placing fintech country managers in ME were not identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search for ME recruitment agencies ('agencija za zapošljavanje', 'headhunting Crna Gora') and monitor their placement announcements.

coverage_gaps.description: Little 2025-2026 material surfaced for local startup hiring; unclear which local sources are still actively publishing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a freshness check on digitalizuj.me, ictcortex.me and portalanalitika.me publication dates before assigning them to a collection schedule.

brief: Montenegro's fintech/crypto staffing signal is almost entirely soft: there is no dedicated appointments tracker, and the authoritative layer (CBCG registers of payment and e-money institutions, the CBCG FinTech Hub) only marks market entry, not people. The practical detection stack is therefore three-part — local job boards (Zaposli.ME, Prekoveze.me, Radnik.me, Pazar3.me, Infostud ME) for hiring and first-office signals, ecosystem pointers (ICT Cortex member list, NTP/Startup Index, Innovation Fund awards, Tracxn/Dealroom) for the actor map, and company/conference pages (Coinis, INFINTECH, Spark.me, The Org) for leadership names. LinkedIn is the richest venue but is login-walled and ToS-prohibited for scraping, so this cell will under-detect without manual analyst review or a licensed provider. The largest open gap is the coast — Tivat, Budva and Porto Montenegro, where relocated crypto teams cluster and virtually nothing is indexed.
